email.subject: Trusty Co Plumbing: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked Trusty Co Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching for a plumber can't tap to reach you, and there's no online booking, so anyone who'd rather not call just leaves. On top of that, the site has no reviews shown and is loaded down with heavy images that slow it on phones.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I found, no pitch. Want me to send a couple times this week?

Alex
